row.notes: Generic open-addressing hash map find-or-insert with FNV-1a 64 over an 8-byte key (param_3) times seed +0x10; control bytes +0x20, slots +0x18 (16 bytes), mask +0x30, size +0x28/limit +0x38, grow 0x143ee2c40 (up to 0x100 tries). Returns {slot index, status 1 found, 2/3 inserted, 0 grow failed}. Callers are not particle code only (0x143df2ea0, 0x14477d2d0, others listed); old particle name was a guess. (lane owner review requested) Better name: Game_HashMapFnv64_FindOrInsert (bound record keeps its name).
